name: Arcanagos
shortDescription: Arcanagos, represented in the Karazhan research story.
body: A living blue dragon in Medivh’s journal memory; the Nightbane quest identifies the revived dragon’s remains as Arcanagos. The art is an original AI-generated interpretation, not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, formation, or simultaneous presence.
